description: List ads in an account, optionally filtered to one ad group. Returns ad records only, not creative copy: use get_ad_creative for headline and body text, or compare_ads to rank one ad group's ads by spend.

account_id.description: Ad account id. Falls back to REDDIT_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID.

ad_group_id.description: Only return ads in this ad group.

name: get_ads
